vb_textbox.text: This game is fun and easy if you get involved! Place your fore fingers on the k and s keys, and your thumb on the spacebar. I think the probability that a gnome will be a good choice varies throughout the game, so don't just stick to your initial thoughts (green is better than red etc.) as this will update. I found that it tended to work in pairs - if red was performing well then purple would also perform well and if green was performing well brown would perform well. In as far as I could tell it didn't matter which side of the screen the gnome was on but I'd get involved and give it a go to see if you can work out any rules!
